name: Non root containers
description: Fail containers that are not explicitly required to run as non-root.
long_description: ISM-1246 (partial): Findings show selected Kubernetes workload hardening settings; they do not prove that all ASD and vendor guidance was identified, reconciled or implemented. ISM-1604 (partial): Findings show selected container isolation and workload hardening settings; they do not assess the Kubernetes control plane, node runtime configuration or every administrative interface used to manage the isolation mechanism.
remediation: Set runAsNonRoot=true in each container securityContext or the pod securityContext.

provenance.rationale: The local rule retains the upstream non-root intent while evaluating pod and container security contexts directly.
